description: A raw body written in `lift` markup renders the same as at top level: active HTML is text, `${…}` is not interpolated, an entity displays decoded, the bare `<code>` wrapper stays an element, and an apostrophe in the body does not disturb the markup after it.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 Q21 "I like a." · gap:g-lift-pre-code-not-raw-content-s462 (change s465-lift-pre-raw)
rationale: §4.17: the element names `pre` and `code` are raw-content elements; inside the body `${...}` SHALL NOT be recognized as a logic-context interpolation and `<TagName ...>` SHALL NOT be recognized as a markup-element opener. (S462 Q21) every `<` and `>` in a raw-content body SHALL be written as `<` / `>` to every output the body reaches, including the client DOM a `lift` builds; a balanced, attribute-less nested `<code>` / `<pre>` stays an element.
